panels.title: Internal HTTP probe result
panels.description: 1 = passed, 0 = failed, no data = unknown. Caddy and web must serve the application shell. Airflow must report healthy scheduler, DAG processor, and metadata database. This does not check public DNS/TLS or DAG run outcomes.

panels.title: Docker volume filesystem free space
panels.description: Bytes available to unprivileged processes on the default Docker volume filesystem. Missing or stale data is unknown. This is not a quota and does not cover other mounts.

panels.title: Synthetic editor startup
panels.description: 1 = signed in and loaded the private project, 0 = check failed, no data = unknown or unconfigured. Runs every five minutes without modifying project data.

targets.expr: trip_editor_probe_success and on (job,instance) (up{job="trip-editor-probe"} == 1) and on (job,instance) (time() - timestamp(trip_editor_probe_success) < 90)
